# TaleemMarkaz

> TaleemMarkaz.com is Pakistan's largest free repository of board exam study material — past papers, textbooks, notes, quizzes, result gazettes, pairing schemes and guess papers — organised by board, class and subject for every major Pakistani educational board.

## About
- **Official domain:** https://taleemmarkaz.com
- **Owner:** TaleemMarkaz (independent, student-focused platform)
- **Contact email:** taleemmarkazofficial@gmail.com
- **WhatsApp:** +92 337 9244731
- **Content count:** 12,700+ free resources
- **Boards covered:** Punjab (PTB), Federal (FBISE), Sindh (STBB), KPK (KPTBB), Balochistan (BTBB), AJK (AJKTB)
- **Classes covered:** 0 (ECCE/Kachi) through 12

## What we offer
- Official past papers (2011–2026) from every BISE
- Complete textbook library (all boards, all classes, both mediums)
- Result gazettes with full roll-number lists
- Chapter-wise study notes (coming soon)
- Interactive quizzes (coming soon)
- Guess papers and pairing schemes (coming soon)
